reuse.why: Reuses the shared extractTagsFromText for #fixed detection, getSheetValue/setBudget and the existing mutator(undoable(...)) registration, and replaces three copied hidden-filter queries with one selector.

duplication.why: Category selection is unified in getMonthWideCategories, but the income-in-tracking-only check is still repeated in every action loop and copied again into setLastMonthSpending together with the expense sign flip used by set3MonthAvg.

placement.why: The selector and the new action live in budget/actions.ts next to the other month-wide actions, and the method is registered in budget/app.ts like its siblings.

scope.why: Changes cover only the four requested behaviours, their handler registration and tests.

maintainability.why: One selector with one real parameter (includeHiddenCategories) is easy to extend, but the income rule living outside it means a future action must remember to re-add it.

bypasses_abstraction.where: none; every month-wide action (copyPreviousMonth via an eligible-id set) takes its categories from getMonthWideCategories

disguised_duplication.where: none; the repeated income check and sign flip are verbatim copies, not reshaped

abstraction_drift.where: getMonthWideCategories gains only includeHiddenCategories; the income-category rule stays at each caller (copyPreviousMonth, setZero, setLastMonthSpending, set3/6/12MonthAvg) rather than in the selector
